reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is a coordination failure: scientists recognize existential risks but lack enforcement power. This mirrors the 'tragedy of the commons' where individual rationality (exultation over power) destroys collective welfare (survival). The solution requires building credibility through transparent education, overcoming the 'medicine-man' stigma. The transition from atomic supremacy to mutual assured destruction (MAD) creates a dual equilibrium: one where unilateral force dominates, and another where cooperative verification prevents annihilation. The key variable is the rate of information diffusion versus weapon deployment.
